_comment: THE single source for the credential shapes an MCP server document may never carry. Both languages read THIS file: the web tier generates web/app/lib/mcp/secret-patterns.generated.ts from it (bun run gen:mcp-patterns; check:mcp-patterns fails on drift), and a client-side reader can load it directly. Each regex is plain ECMAScript source, unanchored, matched case-sensitively against the whole raw document text. The entropy block is the belt below the named shapes: a token of at least minLength characters from [A-Za-z0-9_+=-] whose Shannon entropy (bits/char) reaches threshold AND which mixes lower/upper/digit reads as a random secret; a long all-hex run does too. Both rules live in the TS module and are documented there.
